def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']  # number of people
    k = inputs['k']  # every k-th person is eliminated
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position (1-indexed)
    # Using the iterative approach
    
    # Build a list of people (0-indexed internally, convert to 1-indexed at the end)
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    idx = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Remove every k-th person
        idx = (idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(idx)
        # idx now points to the next person to start counting from
        if idx == len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            idx = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
